title: Apache Pulsar connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Pulsar cluster's settings (CN2 Task 18, loams_connector_brokers::pulsar): durable subscriptions acknowledged after the Fabric, and a producer for the sink (at least once, R18.7).

token.description: A JWT for token authentication. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

ca_pem.description: PEM CA bundle for pulsar+ssl:// (not a secret).

source.description: The source: topics, one split each.

receiver_queue_size.description: The receiver queue; by default the pipeline's in-flight budget.

max_batch.description: Messages per batch at most (the pipeline's budget may be smaller).

poll_wait_ms.description: How long one read waits for the first message before reporting nothing.

producer_name.description: The producer name; unique per sink session by default.

send_timeout_ms.description: How long a batch waits for its send receipts.

pipeline.description: The SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (`PipelineConfig::with_overrides`): max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms and retry. The broker-side window (prefetch, credit, Receive Maximum, max_ack_pending, receiver queue) is derived from them unless set.
